min_demand.value: Minimum monthly bill = Basic Service Charge + Demand Charge + Incremental Generation, Transmission, Fuel Transportation and PPA Charges; the demand and incremental generation charges apply to the greatest of Contracted Capacity Demand, Billing Demand or 90 percent of the highest Billing Demand of the previous 11 months (LLCS-1 Incremental Generation Charge $18.98 per kW); Load Ramp Period not to exceed five years

The Load Ramp Period, not to exceed five (5) years, and the Contracted Capacity Demand during the Load Ramp Period shall be agreed upon by Tampa Electric and the Customer in the LLCC

cites.quote: shall be delivered to the Company no later than five (5) days after the Effective Date of this Agreement

for a Customer without an Investment Grade Credit Rating will be Security in the amount of $2.0 million multiplied by the MW Contracted Capacity Demand.
